answer_1.quote: The surge of downstream applications for opendomain natural language generation (NLG), such as dialog systems and story generators necessitates automatic evaluation metrics for quality assessment.

answer_2.quote: The existence of accurate automatic evaluation metrics can accelerate the development cycle by facilitating the process of model comparison and hyperparameter search.

answer_3.quote: Binary classifiers trained on this data can produce the probability of plausible/implausible labels for each text. The predicted probability of the positive class is interpreted as the text's plausibility score.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgments through Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) experiments.
answer_4.guideline: Five distinct participants are asked to rate each story on a scale of 0 to 5 (from not at all plausible to completely plausible).
